hero.title: Launch & Support Real World Projects
hero.text: Explore the projects in our ecosystem, each backed by real-world economic drivers.

items.question: Who can take part in projects?
items.answer: Each project sets its own requirements. Open a project to see who it's for and how to get involved.

items.question: How do I get involved?
items.answer: Choose a project and follow its link. You'll be taken to the project's own site to complete the next steps.

items.question: How are projects selected?
items.answer: Every project is reviewed before it's listed. Look for the verified badge next to a project's name.
